title: System diagnosis
intro: Checks whether Nodestro works completely on this computer: versions, database, directories, sandbox and requirements. The diagnosis is free and sends nothing to the internet.
connectionNote: The connection test asks the provider of the default model for its list of models. It uses no tokens and costs nothing.
noSecrets: The diagnosis never shows API keys or other credentials.

database.title: Database
database.no_fts: Full-text search (FTS5) is missing in this SQLite version.

fix.unreadable: Check path and permissions: {{path}}. Is Nodestro perhaps running twice?
fix.no_fts: Knowledge search then finds less. Install a Python with complete SQLite (e.g. from python.org).

fix.not_writable: Give your user write permission for the folder or set NODESTRO_DATA_DIR to another folder.
Without write permission no custom tools can be saved.
Without write permission no safety backup can be made before a restore.

fix.low: Free up space, for example by deleting old executions or backups.

docker.title: Docker
docker.not_installed: Not installed. AI-created tools need the built-in Linux sandbox or Docker.
docker.unreachable: The sandbox is set to Docker, but Docker cannot be reached.

fix.unreachable: Start Docker Desktop or switch the sandbox to “Python process”.

sandbox.title: Tool sandbox
sandbox.ok: A test tool ran in {{seconds}} s.
sandbox.failed: A test tool could not be run.

fix.failed: Custom tools do not work like this. Check the details and the sandbox setting.

fix.missing: Reinstall the dependencies (pip install -e .) so PDFs can be loaded into knowledge.
Build it with “npm run build” in the frontend folder, or use the development server.

connection.title: Connection to the AI provider
connection.no_key: {{label}} has no API key, so the connection cannot be checked.

fix.key_rejected: Check the key with the provider and enter it again.
fix.unreachable: Check the internet connection, a firewall or a proxy, and whether the server is running.
fix.api_error: Try again later; details are below.
fix.not_configured: Enter the base URL of the server first.

connection.not_configured: {{label}} has no base URL yet, so the connection cannot be checked.

providers.title: AI providers
providers.missing: {{provider}} is used by the default or assistant model but is not set up.

fix.missing: Enter its access above under “AI providers”. Without it these models do not run.
